scripts.test:unit: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "yarn workspace @klurigo/common test:unit" "yarn workspace @klurigo/klurigo-service test:unit" "yarn workspace @klurigo/klurigo-web test:unit"
scripts.test:unit:coverage: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail "yarn workspace @klurigo/common test:unit:coverage" "yarn workspace @klurigo/klurigo-service test:unit:coverage" "yarn workspace @klurigo/klurigo-web test:unit:coverage"
